author: duclvQ
description:
VTV24 Video Retrieval Benchmark
	

This dataset contains 10 VTV24 videos and 33 query-to-timestamp annotations for video retrieval benchmarking. The videos are provided as 360p MP4 files, alongside video-retrieval-benchmark.json.
The annotation tool is available at https://github.com/duclvq/video-retrieval-bench.
No license claim is made over the source broadcasts; users are responsible for ensuring that their use complies with applicable rights and terms.
